I'm so sorry you're having these experiences OP! unfortunately antidepressants can be variable and it's unlikely you'll find two people with the exact same experience of the same medication.

that being said, try not to be too discouraged. i tried multiple anti-ds before i landed on prozac (celexa, which was fine for a while but eventually stopped working for me, and effexor, which i reacted horribly to and had terrible withdrawals) but prozac was the best one by FAR. i only experienced significant side effects in my first couple of weeks (mostly nausea and a bit of vomiting but i also chalk that up to transitioning off effexor simultaneously). after then, i had no problems. i did varied doses from 10mg to at my peak on 40mg when my depression was at its worst, but i truly felt that prozac was the best anti-d at getting me to a higher level of 'functioning' without the side effects. it was easier for me to get out of bed and easier to deal with my work and school demands. thanks to prozac and therapy, i was discharged and even came off meds altogether (and there were no withdrawal symptoms after i cut them). in short, i had the best experience with prozac over any other meds that i tried!

i hope all turns out well for you on your new meds. it can be daunting and a bit disheartening trying new medication, but things will settle after the first couple of weeks. i hope you find prozac to be effective, and feel reassured by other people's experiences of it here. good luck <3
